summary_en: 1,300,000 shares (6.07% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥6.0B upper limit, open-market purchase window Aug 7, 2026–Jul 31, 2027. Acquired shares to be cancelled under treasury cap policy (10% of issued shares). Rationale: capital-efficiency response to 3-year consolidated payout-ratio floor of 50%+ under mid-term plan PROGRESSIVE PLUS 2027; consolidated dividend policy maintained at 40%+.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief: ESPEC Corp. announced on 6 August 2026 a treasury stock buyback program authorized by board resolution under the Companies Act (Article 165(3) read with Article 156). The company will acquire up to 1,300,000 shares (6.07% of shares outstanding ex-treasury, calculated from 21,407,674 shares issued) for a maximum of ¥6.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 7 August 2026 and 31 July 2027. Acquired shares are to be cancelled under the company's treasury cap policy (10% of issued stock maximum), subject to a separate cancellation notice. Rationale: the buyback supports the company's capital-allocation strategy under its 3-year mid-term plan PROGRESSIVE PLUS 2027 (fiscal 2025–2027), which targets a cumulative consolidated payout ratio of 50% or higher and maintains no dividend cuts. The company frames ongoing share repurchases as integral to its core shareholder-return policy, which targets a consolidated dividend payout ratio of 40% or higher alongside dynamic deployment of capital.
